See the Office of Admissions website for current admission requirements. Completion of all coursework listed in this agreement is not necessarily mandatory prior to admission. notes.content: Minimum grade of c- in major courses
Students must earn a minimum grade of C- in all courses taken to fulfill the major requirements; and must earn a minimum overall GPA of 2.0 in the major.
